description: A report script for item shortage analysis in ERPNext, generating a table and bar chart of items with negative projected quantities, filtered by warehouse and company.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns, data, and chart data based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions string based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches item stock data with projected_qty < 0, filtered by conditions.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for bar chart visualization of item projected quantities.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the report columns with labels, field types, and options.
